permissions.description: Native standard Modbus TCP through retained builtin-only client. Explicit host/port/unit, bounded single request and confirmed equipment writes; no authentication/secrets/TLS or automatic retries. Filesystem metadata is conservatively declared because static audit classifies client.open() as local open; reviewed emitted code imports only node:net/events and performs no local file access.

definitions.name: Modbus Read Coils
definitions.documentation: One fresh TCP connection and one request, retries=0. Addresses are zero-based protocol offsets 0..65535; 40001 means holding register address0 only with explicit reference conversion. Unit1..255 (broadcast0 rejected). Standard TCP has no TLS/authentication; no secrets are read. Optional config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config; credentials ignored. Total wall deadline begins before profile/import and all late continuations check it. Every write requires request.confirm=true, may have an uncertain outcome on failure and is never retried. No automatic replay. Reads <=2000 bits/125 registers, write coils<=1968/registers<=123, FC23 writes<=121. Strict bounded MBAP transaction/protocol/unit/length/function and reply correlation. No equipment has been used for validation. modbus-serial@8.0.25 embedded with ISC notices. Sources: https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial

definitions.name: Modbus Read Write Registers
definitions.documentation: One fresh TCP connection and one request, retries=0. Addresses are zero-based protocol offsets 0..65535; 40001 means holding register address0 only with explicit reference conversion. Unit1..255 (broadcast0 rejected). Standard TCP has no TLS/authentication; no secrets are read. Optional config.$connection resolves RuntimeConnection.config; credentials ignored. Total wall deadline begins before profile/import and all late continuations check it. Every write requires request.confirm=true, may have an uncertain outcome on failure and is never retried. No automatic replay. Reads <=2000 bits/125 registers, write coils<=1968/registers<=123, FC23 writes<=121. Strict bounded MBAP transaction/protocol/unit/length/function and reply correlation. No equipment has been used for validation. modbus-serial@8.0.25 embedded with ISC notices. Sources: https://www.modbus.org/modbus-specifications https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/modbusprotocolspecification.pdf https://www.modbus.org/file/secure/messagingimplementationguide.pdf https://github.com/yaacov/node-modbus-serial
